decision_rules: AUTHORIZE only if the exact predecessor closure evidence remains internally consistent and all four exact-head predecessor workflows are SUCCESS.

Before AUTHORIZE, the mandatory hostile review gate must be CLOSED_PASS with exact reviewed-head and review-id evidence and zero unresolved Critical/High findings.
The authorization object keyset is closed; unrecognized authority keys are invalid, and signing, transaction construction, transaction broadcast, and live execution must remain explicitly false.
Authorization scope is exactly the committed 147-launch manifest and the frozen five horizons under the existing historical baseline/outcome policies.
Do not infer that the full replay will be 147/147 COMPLETE from representative 45/45 compatibility; full-cohort failures remain valid results.
Do not change historical pricing, valuation, horizon, authority, notional, or failure semantics to improve replay completion.
Any provider/transport limitation remains explicit and is never economic evidence.

decision_result.rationale: The exact 147-launch scope is committed and independently live-reverified; predecessor evidence remains green; the closed authorization keyset permits only the research full-replay bit; the initial hostile review and single targeted re-review are pinned to their actual review IDs and reviewed heads; the targeted re-review's remaining shape-only binding defect is repaired by hard-pinning that exact evidence with no third review loop under the bounded completion policy. This decision opens only a separate HISTORICAL_FULL_REPLAY_R1 implementation phase and grants no live execution or merge authority.

prohibitions: Do not execute the 147-launch economic replay inside this authorization PR; open the separate HISTORICAL_FULL_REPLAY_R1 implementation phase first.
Do not change current R3 authority, EXECUTABLE_BASELINE_R1, FORWARD_OUTCOMES_R1, or reviewed historical baseline/outcome semantics.

Do not merge without explicit user authority.
Do not create a third review loop after the single targeted re-review; close by exact-head verification of the bounded mechanical repair.
